name: dumbbell half kneeling single arm shoulder press
description: A one-arm overhead press from a half kneeling stance. It trains the shoulder while the position challenges your balance and core.
instructions: Kneel on one knee with the other foot flat in front, and hold a dumbbell at shoulder height.
Brace your core and squeeze the glute of the kneeling leg.
Press the dumbbell straight overhead until your arm is extended.
Lower it under control back to your shoulder.
Finish your reps, then switch sides.
